title: Why the best teams report more mistakes
series: What your workplace is teaching you

scenes.say: The best teams reported more mistakes. Why?
In the nineteen nineties, researcher Amy Edmondson studied hospital teams. She expected better teams to make fewer errors. The data said the opposite.
So were the strongest teams actually worse at their jobs?
Probably not. Her explanation: they were more willing to speak up. Mistakes got reported, discussed, and fixed.
She later called this climate psychological safety. The belief that you won't be punished for speaking up.
So on your team, does a mistake get hidden, or discussed?
